fields.title: Land in Denpasar, drift to Ubud
fields.description: Your host meets you at arrivals and drives you north. Nothing is scheduled tonight beyond dinner on a terrace above the river valley.

fields.title: Terraces at first light
fields.description: Out by 5:30am for Tegallalang while the mist still sits in the valley. Back for a long breakfast, then a free afternoon for the Ubud market or a nap — both defensible.

fields.title: Temples and the Campuhan ridge
fields.description: A morning at Tirta Empul, an afternoon walk along the ridge, and a cooking session with a family in Penestanan.

fields.title: South to Canggu
fields.description: A two-hour drive to the coast. Check in, then your first surf lesson on the beach break at Batu Bolong.

fields.title: Surf, eat, repeat
fields.description: Second surf session at dawn. The rest of the day is deliberately empty — Canggu rewards wandering.

fields.title: Boat to Nusa Penida
fields.description: Fast boat from Sanur. The island is rougher than the mainland and far emptier.

fields.title: Kelingking and the west coast
fields.description: Private boat around the cliffs, snorkelling with manta rays at Manta Point if the swell allows.

fields.title: Back to the mainland
fields.description: Return boat and a slow final evening in Seminyak, with dinner somewhere loud and good.

fields.title: Fly home
fields.description: Late checkout and an airport transfer whenever your flight goes.

fields.title: Arrive and exhale
fields.description: Transfer from the airport, an orientation walk, and dinner in the garden.

fields.title: Yoga and the Ayung valley
fields.description: Morning practice, then a guided walk down into the valley and back up for lunch.

fields.title: Waterfalls
fields.description: An early start to Tibumana and Tegenungan before the day-trippers.

fields.title: Spa and nothing else
fields.description: Deliberately unscheduled. Your treatment is booked for whenever you like.

fields.title: Home
fields.description: Breakfast, checkout, transfer.

fields.title: Land in Leh, do nothing
fields.description: Acclimatisation is the whole job today. You will be told to rest, and you should listen.

fields.title: Monasteries and the Indus valley
fields.description: Thiksey at dawn for prayers, then Hemis and Shey at an unhurried pace.

fields.title: Over Chang La to Pangong
fields.description: Five hours of climbing, a pass at 5,360m, then the lake appears and stops the conversation.

fields.title: Pangong, slowly
fields.description: Sunrise over the water, a walk along the shore to Merak, and a very early night.

fields.title: Nubra via Shyok
fields.description: The rough, beautiful river road north to Hunder and the dunes.

fields.title: Diskit and Khardung La
fields.description: The big Maitreya Buddha in the morning, then back to Leh over the top.

fields.title: Fly out
fields.description: Early transfer for the morning flight — the only one that reliably gets out.

fields.title: Arrive in Kyoto
fields.description: Airport express from Kansai, check into the machiya, then a walk through Gion at dusk.

fields.title: Arashiyama at dawn
fields.description: Out at 5:45am for the bamboo grove and Tenryu-ji before anyone else. Afternoon free.

fields.title: The eastern hills
fields.description: Kiyomizu-dera, the stone lanes of Ninen-zaka, and Kodai-ji lit up after dark.

fields.title: Fushimi Inari and tea
fields.description: The full gate circuit up the mountain, then a private tea ceremony in the afternoon.

fields.title: Philosopher's Path
fields.description: A slow north-to-south walk via Ginkaku-ji, ending with kaiseki.

fields.title: Depart
fields.description: Nishiki market for last-minute food, then the train to Kansai.

fields.title: Arrive Santorini
fields.description: Transfer to Imerovigli, then the first of many caldera sunsets.

fields.title: The caldera walk
fields.description: Fira to Oia on foot, starting at 7am. Afternoon by the pool, because you earned it.

fields.title: Catamaran day
fields.description: Red Beach, White Beach, the hot springs and lunch on board.

fields.title: Inland Santorini
fields.description: Pyrgos, Emporio and a long afternoon at a winery that predates the tourism.

fields.title: Ferry to Naxos
fields.description: Two hours across. Naxos Town's Venetian quarter in the evening.

fields.title: Mountain villages
fields.description: Halki, Apeiranthos and the marble quarries, with lunch at a taverna with four tables.

fields.title: Beach day
fields.description: Plaka and Mikri Vigla, both long and mostly empty.

fields.title: Depart
fields.description: Morning ferry or flight out of Naxos.

fields.title: Land at Keflavík
fields.description: Transfer to Reykjavík, an orientation walk and an early night.

fields.title: Golden Circle
fields.description: Þingvellir, Geysir and Gullfoss, ending at a lodge in the south with dark skies.

fields.title: Waterfall day
fields.description: Seljalandsfoss, Skógafoss and the black sands at Reynisfjara.

fields.title: Glacier and lagoon
fields.description: Morning hike on Sólheimajökull, afternoon at Jökulsárlón and the Diamond Beach.

fields.title: Back west
fields.description: A long, spectacular drive returning to Reykjavík with stops as the light allows.

fields.title: Blue Lagoon and out
fields.description: A soak on the way to the airport, which is the correct order.

fields.title: Arrive and raft
fields.description: Check into camp by noon, then the afternoon run from Shivpuri to Rishikesh.

fields.title: Full-day river
fields.description: The long 26km stretch with a beach lunch, followed by an evening at the aarti.

fields.title: Trek and out
fields.description: A short waterfall trek before checkout at 11am.

fields.title: Arrive Queenstown
fields.description: Transfer from the airport and a gondola ride for the view before dinner.

fields.title: Lake day
fields.description: Glenorchy road, a short hike at the head of the lake, and a free afternoon.

fields.title: The Routeburn
fields.description: A guided day section of the Great Walk. Long, steep and worth it.

fields.title: To Te Anau
fields.description: Drive south, stopping at Mirror Lakes. Evening walk along the Te Anau waterfront.

fields.title: Milford Sound
fields.description: The Homer Tunnel road, then a two-hour cruise out to the open sea.

fields.title: Back north, your call
fields.description: Return to Queenstown. The afternoon is yours — this is when the bungee voucher gets used.

fields.title: Depart
fields.description: Airport transfer.

fields.title: Arrive in Lisbon
fields.description: Settle into Príncipe Real, then a sunset miradouro and dinner nearby.

fields.title: Alfama and Belém
fields.description: Tram 28 up, walk down through Alfama, then Belém in the afternoon.

fields.title: Sintra
fields.description: Pena, Regaleira and Cabo da Roca with a driver, avoiding the queues.

fields.title: South to Comporta
fields.description: An hour's drive to rice paddies and pine forest behind 12km of beach.

fields.title: Beach and nothing
fields.description: Deliberately empty. Surf, horse ride or read — all available, none compulsory.

fields.title: Back and out
fields.description: Return to Lisbon for the flight.

fields.title: Arrive Cape Town
fields.description: Transfer to the City Bowl and an easy first evening.

fields.title: Table Mountain
fields.description: Up Platteklip at 6am, down by cable car, afternoon at the V&A.

fields.title: The peninsula
fields.description: Chapman's Peak, Cape Point, Boulders Beach and back along False Bay.

fields.title: Winelands
fields.description: Stellenbosch in the morning, Franschhoek after lunch, with a driver throughout.

fields.title: Slow morning, fly east
fields.description: A second tasting, then the afternoon flight to the reserve.

fields.title: Safari
fields.description: Dawn and dusk game drives with a long lunch and a nap between them.

fields.title: Safari
fields.description: As yesterday, with a walking safari option in the morning.

fields.title: Final drive, fly back
fields.description: Last dawn drive, then the flight to Cape Town.

fields.title: Beach and Bo-Kaap
fields.description: Camps Bay in the morning, the Bo-Kaap and a food tour in the afternoon.

fields.title: Depart
fields.description: Airport transfer.

fields.title: Arrive, find the sea
fields.description: Transfer from Dabolim or Mopa, check in and do nothing.

fields.title: Palolem and Butterfly
fields.description: Sunrise kayak to Butterfly Beach, back for breakfast, afternoon at Palolem.

fields.title: Inland day
fields.description: Scooter to a spice plantation, then the Netravali bubble lake on the way back.

fields.title: Cabo de Rama
fields.description: The fort ruins and the cliff beach below, which is usually empty.

fields.title: Depart
fields.description: A last swim and an airport transfer.

fields.title: Arrive and go up
fields.description: Check in Downtown, then Burj Khalifa 148 timed for sunset.

fields.title: Old Dubai
fields.description: Abra across the creek, both souks, and the Al Fahidi quarter.

fields.title: Into the desert
fields.description: Afternoon pickup, dune bashing, camel ride and a camp dinner under the stars.

fields.title: Beach, then home
fields.description: Sunrise over the dunes, back to the city for Kite Beach and the airport.

fields.title: Port Blair and Ross
fields.description: Land, transfer, and an afternoon at Ross Island and the Cellular Jail show.

fields.title: Ferry to Havelock
fields.description: Morning catamaran, check in, sunset at Radhanagar.

fields.title: Dive day
fields.description: Two guided dives in the morning, an empty afternoon at Elephant Beach.

fields.title: On to Neil
fields.description: Short ferry south. Bharatpur snorkelling and the rock bridge at low tide.

fields.title: Neil, unhurried
fields.description: Laxmanpur for sunset, and very little else on the schedule.

fields.title: Back to Port Blair
fields.description: Ferry and airport transfer.

fields.name: Aanya Kulkarni
fields.quote: I've booked a lot of trips and this is the first time the itinerary actually matched the photos. The Ubud sunrise bit is worth every bit of the 5am alarm.

fields.name: Rohan Mehta
fields.quote: They put an oxygen cylinder in the car and told me to sit still on day one. Two of my friends who booked elsewhere spent day two with altitude sickness. Small thing, huge difference.

fields.name: Tara Fernandes
fields.quote: Scooter included was the detail that sold me. Four days of turning down random lanes and finding beaches with nobody on them.

fields.name: Ishaan Verma
fields.quote: The bamboo grove at 6am was genuinely empty. By 9am there were four hundred people there. Timing is the entire product and they know it.

fields.name: Meera Nair
fields.quote: Three aurora nights booked in on purpose instead of hoping. We got it on the second. Guide pulled over at 11pm and just let us stand there.

fields.name: Dev Patel
fields.quote: Ten days, zero admin. I got a WhatsApp message before every single transfer. Booking a safari usually means six emails with a lodge — this was one payment.
